review: Reviewed Lin actual round-19 request and accepted world-47 specification. One study round precedes a fresh 0.5-energy examination and up to two 1-energy manual rounds. Finite authored loose-cover representation has explicit terrain provenance, never sprite-derived inventory or food. Cover displacement conserves exact mass as non-food non-harvestable residues within the same footprint. The unchanged whole-footprint planting predicate determines compatibility; residue leaves this bounded attempt partial rather than successful. No crops, nutrients, mastery, rewards, automatic work or resource grants. Exact job identity, paid progress and physical lock survive pauses; cancellation/death release only lock while conserving physical changes, and repeats never reset cover. Individually trained other actors can work after release. Scope is long-ex13 only. Read-only replay renders actual examination, affected area and residues. Tests exercise conservation, learning/isolation, interruption/recovery, competing workers, repeated attempts, cancellation/death and historical coordinates; full adapter checks and exact prefix reconstruction are required.
